meta.name: multicore
meta.description: Developing for multicore systems in Zephyr RTOS. Covers Symmetric Multiprocessing (SMP), Asymmetric Multiprocessing (AMP) with OpenAMP/RPMsg, inter-processor communication (IPC) patterns, and Linkable Extensions (LLEXT). Trigger when designing for SoCs with multiple homogeneous or heterogeneous cores.

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用Zephyr RTOS开发多核嵌入式设备
copy.tagline_en: Design IPC and AMP architectures for multicore SoCs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if developing multicore embedded devices with Zephyr RTOS

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮助你配置 Zephyr RTOS 的多核系统，包括对称多处理（SMP）、非对称多处理（AMP）、核间通信（IPC）和动态加载模块（LLEXT），并验证配置正确性。
howto.when: 当你设计包含多个同质或异构 CPU 核心的 SoC 的 Zephyr 项目时触发。

say.text: 帮我配置 Zephyr SMP，启用双核并设置线程亲和性。
say.note: Claude 会生成相关 Kconfig 和代码示例。

say.text: 用 OpenAMP 在 A 核和 M 核之间建立 RPMsg 通信。
say.note: Claude 会提供配置和代码框架。

say.text: 我需要一个 LLEXT 模块，动态加载执行。
say.note: Claude 会指导模块创建和加载过程。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help configure multicore systems in Zephyr RTOS, covering SMP, AMP, inter-processor communication (IPC), and LLEXT dynamic loading, and verify configuration correctness.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you are designing a Zephyr project for SoCs with multiple homogeneous or heterogeneous CPU cores.

say_en.text: Configure Zephyr SMP with dual cores and thread affinity.
say_en.note: Claude will generate Kconfig and code samples.

say_en.text: Set up OpenAMP RPMsg between A-core and M-core.
say_en.note: Claude will provide config and code skeleton.

say_en.text: I need an LLEXT module for dynamic loading.
say_en.note: Claude will guide module creation and loading.
